class.name: GameplayPawn
class.brief_description: A controllable gameplay embodiment that can be possessed by a [GameplayController].
class.description: GameplayPawn represents the replaceable physical or scene embodiment of a player or agent. Possession is maintained bidirectionally by [method GameplayController.possess]. Gameplay ownership does not grant Godot multiplayer authority; authoritative simulation remains controlled by [method Node.set_multiplayer_authority].

method.name: is_possessed
method.description: Returns whether a live controller possesses this pawn.

members.member: The gameplay owner peer. This is identity metadata and is deliberately separate from multiplayer authority.
